title: Meeting Rooms
description:
`intervals[i] = [start, end]` describes a meeting that runs from time `start` until time `end`. The list is in no particular order.

Return `true` if one person could attend **every** meeting, i.e. no two meetings overlap. A meeting that ends at time `t` does **not** clash with one that starts at time `t`.

examples.explanation: Sorted by start the meetings are [4,9], [9,10], [13,15]; the first two only touch at 9.
With no meetings there is nothing to clash.

seedMeta.notes: NeetCode's version passes Interval objects; here meetings are int pairs, which keeps the format language-neutral.
